title: Trainability Beyond Linearity in Variational Quantum Objectives
summary: Barren-plateau results have established exponential gradient suppression as a widely cited obstacle to the scalability of variational quantum algorithms. When and whether these results extend to a given objective has been addressed through loss-specific arguments, but a general structural characterization has remained open. We show that the objective itself admits a fixed-observable representation if and only if the loss is affine in the measured statistics, thereby identifying the exact boundary of the standard concentration-based proof template.
